Chasing costs 13.7 runs in the ILT20 — but that hides a wide spread

Across 489 matches at these grounds a first innings averages 147.6 and a chase 133.9, at 7.04 runs an over. On first-innings scoring that places the ILT20 8th among the 10 T20 leagues we hold ground data for, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.

The league average is the least interesting number on this page. Chasing costs 14.6 runs at Dubai International Cricket Stadium and only 12.2 at Sharjah Cricket Stadium. The highest-scoring ground on the list is Sharjah Cricket Stadium at 7.09 an over. A total that wins comfortably at one of these grounds loses at another.

These are T20 records for each ground rather than for this competition alone, so treat them as ground character. Sample sizes vary a lot — a ground with five matches behind it deserves far less weight than one with a hundred, and both are in the table rather than hidden behind an average. The live model does not use these figures: once a ball is bowled it reads the actual over-by-over run and wicket pattern instead.

How the live prediction works

It starts when the match does. There is no pre-match tip here. Win probability is recalculated after every ball from the score, wickets in hand, balls and runs remaining, and how the pitch is behaving in this innings rather than on average.

Measured, not claimed. 81.5% win-probability accuracy on a true holdout: trained on 2017-2024 matches only, then scored on 2,546 matches from 2025-26 the model had never seen. Accuracy rises through an innings, from 79.2% at over 6 to 82.2% by over 15.

Next-over forecasts too. Expected runs for the coming over land inside the published range 72.3% of the time, measured across 46,718 over-boundary snapshots.

ILT20 predictions — FAQs

Which ILT20 ground is hardest to chase at?
Dubai International Cricket Stadium. Across 218 matches there, sides batting first average 148.5 and sides chasing 133.9 — a 14.6-run gap. The most forgiving is Sharjah Cricket Stadium, where the same gap is 12.2.
What is a good score in the International League T20?
Across 489 matches at the grounds listed, a first innings averages 147.6 and a chase 133.9, at 7.04 runs an over. That puts the ILT20 8th of the 10 T20 leagues we track for first-innings scoring, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.
Who will win tonight's ILT20 match?
We do not publish pre-match tips.
